# Creating a note returns nothing — the id has to be read back

**Claim.** Success is a bare 204: no body, no Location header, no noteId. The only way to learn the new id is GET /people/{vanId}/notes. The read-back also shows `isPinned` was accepted and ignored, and that an uncategorized note reads as the `{noteCategoryId: 0, name: null}` stub.

Applies to: `~1people~1{vanId}~1notes/post`, `~1people~1{vanId}~1notes/get`

## Observed exchange

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Lucinda",
  "lastName": "Farrow-{scope}"
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_Create a note, asking for a pin the API will ignore._

```http
POST /people/100000001/notes

{
  "text": "Spoke at the door; wants a yard sign.",
  "isViewRestricted": false,
  "isPinned": true
}

→ 204
```

_Reading the list back is the only way to learn the noteId._

```http
GET /people/100000001/notes

→ 200
{
  "items": [
    {
      "contactHistory": null,
      "noteId": 100000002,
      "text": "Spoke at the door; wants a yard sign.",
      "isViewRestricted": false,
      "category": {
        "noteCategoryId": 0,
        "name": null
      },
      "createdDate": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "isPinned": false
    }
  ],
  "nextPageLink": null,
  "count": 1
}
```
